scenarios.title: A permanent with devoid is colorless although its mana cost has a color

setup.notes: Culling Drone costs {1}{B}, is a 2/2 with devoid and ingest. The board is stable and observed with no further actions.

decisions: No action is taken; the colors of B's creature on the battlefield are read.

variants.label: devoid
variants.expected: Culling Drone is colorless: it has no color although its mana cost contains black.

variants.label: no_devoid
variants.delta: B's creature is Walking Corpse (a 2/2 with the same mana cost {1}{B} and no devoid) instead of Culling Drone.

scenarios.title: A colorless devoid creature is a legal target for a nonblack-creature spell

setup.notes: Doom Blade ({1}{B} instant) destroys target nonblack creature. Culling Drone has a black mana cost and devoid.

decisions: A considers casting Doom Blade targeting B's creature, tapping both Swamps; the engine's verdict on that target is read.

variants.label: devoid
variants.expected: Culling Drone is a legal target for Doom Blade (it is colorless, so nonblack), and can_play is true.

variants.label: black_without_devoid
variants.delta: B's creature is Walking Corpse (black, no devoid) instead of Culling Drone.
variants.expected: Walking Corpse is not a legal target for Doom Blade: it is black, so Doom Blade has no legal target and cannot be cast.

scenarios.title: A devoid spell on the stack is colorless

setup.notes: Mist Intruder ({1}{U}, 1/2, devoid, flying, ingest) has a blue mana cost. Pyroblast ({R} instant) is a choice of countering target spell if it is blue, or destroying target permanent if it is blue.

decisions: B casts Mist Intruder, tapping both Islands.
A responds with Pyroblast, tapping Mountain, choosing the counter mode and targeting Mist Intruder.
Both players pass; Pyroblast resolves, then Mist Intruder resolves if it is still on the stack.

variants.label: devoid_spell
variants.expected: Pyroblast resolves but does not counter Mist Intruder, because it is colorless on the stack. Mist Intruder then resolves and enters the battlefield under B's control.

variants.label: blue_spell
variants.delta: B casts Coral Merfolk (a blue 2/1 with the same cost {1}{U} and no devoid) instead of Mist Intruder.
variants.expected: Pyroblast counters Coral Merfolk because it is blue; Coral Merfolk goes to B's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Pyroblast's counter mode can target any spell and checks the color on resolution (ConditionPresent$ Spell.Blue).
